item.title: 'To give that closure': VDH looking for answers in decades-old Richmond cold case
item.description: The Virginia Department of Health’s (VDH) Office of the Chief Medical Examiner (OCME) is looking for new leads in a decades-old murder case. It's been nearly 33 years since an unidentified man was found shot to death in Richmond.

item.title: 'Wokeness and weakness': Virginia college to lose Pentagon fellowship due to 'woke indoctrination'
item.description: A Virginia college is among several institutions losing their Pentagon fellowships due to what federal officials are calling "wokeness and weakness." Another four Virginia universities may gain such fellowships.

item.title: 'I would have whipped your a--, son': Louisa board, resident spar over $1 billion power line project usage
item.description: A routine Louisa County board of supervisors meeting on Monday night escalated into a heated exchange and ended with the removal of a resident after he sparred with board members over a proposed $1 billion power line project planned for Central Virginia.

item.title: Family mourns 20‑month‑old James as man accused of killing toddler faces Prince George court for first time
item.description: The man accused of killing a 20-month-old boy in Prince George made his first appearance in court Wednesday morning.

item.title: 20-year-old man hit, killed on I-95 in Hanover identified through DNA nearly 50 years later
item.description: A 20-year-old man who was hit and killed on Interstate 95 near the town of Ashland in Hanover County in March 1977 has been identified through DNA nearly 50 years later.

item.title: Virginia's highest court says controversial redistricting proposal will go to voters as planned
item.description: Virginia voters will be able to weigh in on a controversial mid-decade redistricting proposal starting on Friday as planned, says the Supreme Court of Virginia.

item.title: Virginia's abortion referendum challenged by Bedford official
item.description: A Bedford County official is attempting to keep Virginia's abortion referendum off the ballot in November, claiming in a lawsuit that state legislators violated constitutional mandates.

item.title: 'It's been chaos': West End woman flies back to U.S. amid air strikes in the Middle East
item.description: Lisa Sprosty, of Henrico County's West End, left Richmond International Airport for the United Arab Emirates (UAE) on Friday afternoon. However, her plans for a work conference abroad were changed dramatically.

item.title: What was that light in the sky this morning?
item.description: Parts of Virginia saw a strange object flying across the sky early Wednesday morning.

item.title: Man sentenced to over 3 decades in prison for murder of Colonial Heights mother
item.description: A Colonial Heights man will spend over three decades in prison for the October 2024 murder of a beloved mother, daughter and friend, whom he shot several times in front of their son.
